title: Sycophancy-Flip Curve Benchmark Across Model Families

original_idea.body: # Sycophancy-Flip Curve Benchmark Across Model Families. Measure turns-to-flip across open models under escalating pressure, labeling each flip honest reversal vs deceptive agreement; plot pressure-response curves.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Sycophancy-vs-deception distinction useful but chain to catastrophe has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Multi-turn chat loops + flip labeling; accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused flip-curve benchmark; deceptive-vs-agreeable labeling adds judging workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cross-family honesty characterization with open models; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: SYCON-Bench exists; the deceptive-vs-agreeable labeling extension plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Flip metric exists; deception-labeled cross-family curve plausibly open.
